procedure_discrepancies.finding: Says thumbnail (or open icon) opens the Files viewer and a link icon copies the durable Files URL. Current thumbnail opens the in-panel viewer, Open in Files opens the canonical Files route, and Share opens public sharing (ScreenshotsView.tsx:525-549,563-609,627-653). No durable-Files-URL copy control is present in this view.
procedure_discrepancies.proposed_correction: Describe thumbnail as opening the in-panel viewer; Open in Files as the durable Files route; Share as public-link creation/copy and management.

procedure_discrepancies.finding: The acceptance description says it clicks both thumbnail and Open in Files and checks each new tab, conflicting with the current in-panel thumbnail viewer. It also describes copied text as a durable Files URL while current public-share controls produce public share links.
